title: Hat tiling heat kernel constant
plain: For a random walk on a hat tiling, find the exact constant in the return probability.
math: Prove $p_{2n}(o,o)\sim\frac{c(o)}{n}$ on the hat graph and show $\frac1{|B_R|}\sum_{o\in B_R}c(o)\to c$ with $c=\frac{\bar d}{2\pi\sqrt{\det\Sigma}}$, computing $\Sigma$ in closed form.
